method: Three independent Chrome processes and contexts; same persisted 201-task project and auth state. First open per entry per process is cold renderer/menu (OS cache is not cleared); ten further opens per entry are warm. Input timestamps are captured in-page on actual pointerdown. Feedback/operable/stable/animation-settled are browser frame observations, not physical presentation. No locator round-trip time is used as latency. Outside click closes both baseline and new panels. Headless measurements do not establish native frame rate.
